build_task_template: use define_task_template decorator to register a PHYRE task with seed range and search parameters
create_container: use vt.add_container to create a goal container from vertex coordinates in the PHYRE scene
add_box: use vt.add_box to create static or dynamic box objects like bridges and walls in the scene
add_convex_polygon: use C.add_convex_polygon with converted vertices to add a slope polygon to the PHYRE scene
update_task_goal: use C.update_task to set the task goal requiring body1 to be touching body2
